comment: The note line of a published build: shown in builds/index.json, builds/index.html and (when the page already has a note banner) at the top of builds/<tag>/. tools/linux/builds-index.py applies it on every index rewrite. Changing a note line is the only change allowed to a published builds/ page (SPEC 17.11).
